nameOrigin: of or relating to the Moon

pokedexEntries.bk: Munna always float in the air. People whose dreams are eaten by them forget what the dreams had been about.

pokedexEntries.wh: It eats the dreams of people and Pokémon. When it eats a pleasant dream, it expels pink-colored mist.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: This Pokémon appears before people and Pokémon who are having nightmares and eats those dreams.

pokedexEntries.x: This Pokémon appears before people and Pokémon who are having nightmares and eats those dreams.

pokedexEntries.or: This Pokémon appears before people and Pokémon who are having nightmares and eats those dreams.

pokedexEntries.y: It eats the dreams of people and Pokémon. When it eats a pleasant dream, it expels pink-colored mist.

pokedexEntries.as: It eats the dreams of people and Pokémon. When it eats a pleasant dream, it expels pink-colored mist.

pokedexEntries.sw: Late at night, it appears beside people’s pillows. As it feeds on dreams, the patterns on its body give off a faint glow.

pokedexEntries.sh: It eats dreams and releases mist. The mist is pink when it’s eating a good dream, and black when it’s eating a nightmare.
